zeus_ai_agent if [ -f /opt/agrs/Projects/US_PIPELINE/US_PIPELINE/data/vectors/processed/osm_power_lines_epsg32613_processed.gpkg ]; then ogrinfo -so /opt/agrs/Projects/US_PIPELINE/US_PIPELINE/data/vectors/processed/osm_power_lines_epsg32613_processed.gpkg 2>/dev/null && echo 'EXISTING_VALID' || echo 'EXISTING_INVALID'; else echo 'NOT_EXISTS'; fi cd /opt/agrs/Projects/US_PIPELINE/US_PIPELINE/data/vectors/raw && curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' --retry 3 --max-time 120 -o osm_power_overpass.json -d 'data=[out:json][timeout:90];(way["power"="line"](44.45,-105.30,44.60,-105.15);way["power"="minor_line"](44.45,-105.30,44.60,-105.15););out body geom;' 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter' 2>&1 ls -la /opt/agrs/Projects/US_PIPELINE/US_PIPELINE/data/vectors/raw/osm_power_overpass.json && python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('/opt/agrs/Projects/US_PIPELINE/US_PIPELINE/data/vectors/raw/osm_power_overpass.json')); print(f'Found {len(data.get(\"elements\", []))} power line elements')" cd /opt/agrs/Projects/US_PIPELINE/US_PIPELINE/data/vectors/raw && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import json

# Read the Overpass JSON
with open('osm_power_overpass.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Convert to GeoJSON
features = []
for element in data.get('elements', []):
    if element.get('type') == 'way' and 'geometry' in element:
        coords = [[pt['lon'], pt['lat']] for pt in element['geometry']]
        tags = element.get('tags', {})
        
        # Extract relevant power line attributes
        properties = {
            'osm_id': element.get('id'),
            'power': tags.get('power', ''),
            'name': tags.get('name', ''),
            'ref': tags.get('ref', ''),
            'operator': tags.get('operator', ''),
            'voltage': tags.get('voltage', ''),
            'cables': tags.get('cables', ''),
            'wires': tags.get('wires', ''),
            'circuits': tags.get('circuits', ''),
            'frequency': tags.get('frequency', '')
        }
        
        feature = {
            'type': 'Feature',
            'geometry': {
                'type': 'LineString',
                'coordinates': coords
            },
            'properties': properties
        }
        features.append(feature)

geojson = {
    'type': 'FeatureCollection',
    'features': features
}

# Write GeoJSON
with open('osm_power_temp.geojson', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(geojson, f)

print(f'Converted {len(features)} power line features to GeoJSON')
if len(features) == 0:
    print('NOTE: No power lines found in this area')
